title: Bug Journal 2026-03-03

content:
Daily Report — 2026-03-02 Daily Overview What was done: Multi-device research and development spanning three major projects: MIHD spatial transcriptomics clustering benchmarks (scGPT+UNI2 fusion experiments, 36 visualizations for weekly report), Desktop Video macOS app critical bug fixes (security-scoped bookmark system, screensaver UI redesign), and Error Recovery Benchmark VLA training (monitored 10 concurrent Pi0.5 LoRA jobs, created external dependencies inventory, diagnosed GPU utilization bottleneck) How it was done: MIHD: systematic pipeline debugging with cache metadata repair and parallel fusion evaluations. Desktop Video: forensic log analysis (4438 lines) revealing root cause, entitlements configuration, SwiftUI material effects. VLA: Slurm cluster management commands (squeue, srun with –jobid to bypass PAM restrictions), systematic config parsing for dependency cataloging, mathematical profiling of action chunking inference patterns Impact: MIHD: discovered fundamental architectural issue where STAIG ignores gene encoder embeddings affecting all published results; completed Monday presentation with 36 visualizations. Desktop Video: eliminated 100% failure rate of video/image restoration after app restart (Code 257 errors). VLA: delivered accurate training progress (an49 38% complete ~37h remaining, an53 27% ~46h remaining), created comprehensive dependency inventory covering 65+ GB across 10 categories, identified root cause of 10% GPU utilization enabling future optimization DCC What was done: MIHD scGPT+UNI2 fusion experiments (11 sections × 5 fusion methods = 55 evaluations), weekly report compilation with 3 statistical charts + 33 per-section clustering visualizations How it was done: Pipeline config yaml + phase2_evaluate.py for parallel experiment execution; matplotlib/seaborn for publication-quality figures; visualize_from_cache.py for per-encoder spatial plots; switched from mclust to kmeans when high-dim embeddings caused hangs Impact: Key scientific finding: STAIG two-stage fusion uses raw HVG matrix instead of gene encoder output → scGPT+UNI2+STAIG = PCA+UNI2+STAIG (ARI 0.546). QFormer achieved best scGPT fusion (ARI 0.370 vs 0.170 gene-only, +118%). Ready for Monday lab meeting with complete evidence MacBook What was done: Desktop Video app: fixed critical security-scoped bookmark bugs (4 bugs: entitlements missing, errorLog concurrency, log spam, double window open) + explored and implemented liquid glass screensaver clock effects How it was done: Forensic log analysis (879 updateClockLabels calls, 671 timer logs) revealed empty entitlements file → bookmark creation always failed → Code 257 on restore. Solution: added com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-scope + non-scoped fallback parsing + activeSecurityScopedURLs lifecycle tracking. UI: researched SwiftUI .glassEffect() and .mask() + .ultraThinMaterial for glass text effect Impact: Eliminated 100% failure rate of video/image restoration after app restart (affected all users since v1.0). Reduced log noise by 1550+ spam entries per session. Implemented liquid glass screensaver clock matching macOS native aesthetic, though user later requested fully transparent variant and reported video switching freeze issue tianhe What was done: Monitored 10 concurrent Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning jobs across GPU nodes an49 (6 tasks, 38.3% progress) and an53 (4 tasks, 26.8% progress), created comprehensive external dependencies inventory with 14 categories covering 65+ GB of assets, and diagnosed GPU utilization bottleneck in VLA evaluation pipeline How it was done: Used Slurm commands (squeue, srun –jobid, nvidia-smi) to bypass SSH PAM restrictions, analyzed training logs and checkpoint directories, systematically parsed task_registry.yaml and benchmark configs, created structured markdown inventory with paths/purposes/references, and mathematically profiled action chunking inference pattern (50-step chunks = only 8 GPU calls per 400-step trial) Impact: Delivered accurate training progress reports (an49 tasks ~37h remaining, an53 tasks ~46h remaining), created reusable external_dependencies_inventory.md covering 4 conda envs + 10 datasets + 9 BC-RNN checkpoints + 4 VLA checkpoints + configuration directories + external tools, and identified root cause of 10% GPU utilization (action chunking reduces inference to 8 calls/trial, with GPU work being 20s / 200s total) enabling future batched evaluation optimization Fixed critical MIHD scGPT benchmark bugs discovering STAIG architectural limitation, resolved Desktop Video macOS sandbox permission system with security-scoped bookmarks, monitored large-scale Pi0.5 VLA training across GPU cluster, created comprehensive external dependencies inventory, and diagnosed GPU utilization bottleneck in evaluation pipeline
Tasks Architecture & Strategy ✅ Fix Desktop Video security-scoped bookmark system — Root cause: empty entitlements file → bookmark creation failed silently → Code 257 on restore. Fixed by adding bookmark.app-scope permission + non-scoped fallback parsing in restoreFromBookmark/ensureFileAccess + lifecycle tracking via activeSecurityScopedURLs dict ✅ Create external dependencies inventory for error_recovery_benchmark — Built structured markdown inventory (docs/external_dependencies_inventory.md) cataloging 14 categories of external dependencies: configuration directories, AI assistant logs, external binaries, environment variables, Python packages, Google Drive rclone paths, external Git repos, Ollama models, 4 conda envs, 10 HDF5 datasets (~18.4GB), 9 BC-RNN checkpoints, 4 VLA checkpoints (~47GB), bootstrap procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Updated 项目全景总结.md with references ✅ Run scGPT+UNI2 fusion experiments (5 methods × 11 sections) — Evaluated concat, mean, attention, llava_mlp, qformer fusion strategies. QFormer achieved best performance (avg ARI 0.370 exc 151676). Confirmed STAIG fusion ignores gene encoder ✅ Monitor Pi0.5 LoRA training progress on GPU cluster — Checked status of 10 concurrent training jobs across an49 (6 tasks) and an53 (4 tasks) nodes using Slurm commands, analyzed training logs, GPU utilization, and estimated completion times. Delivered comprehensive report showing 38.3% progress on an49 (~37h remaining) and 26.8% on an53 (~46h remaining) 🔄 Diagnose GPU utilization bottleneck in VLA evaluation pipeline — Identified root cause of ~10% GPU utilization: Pi0.5 action chunking (50-step outputs) reduces inference calls to ~8 per 400-step trial (8 × 2.5s = 20s GPU work / 200s total = 10% utilization). User requested optimization plan with web research on Pi0/Pi0.5 inference techniques and batched evaluation implementation, but task was interrupted before plan completion ✅ Fix scGPT cache metadata and re-evaluate baseline — Added cache_version and metadata_json fields to 11 scGPT .npz files, re-ran phase2_evaluate.py for gene-only clustering. Result: ARI improved from 0.114 (buggy) to 0.170 (+49%) 🔄 Debug Desktop Video transparent label and video switching freeze — User reported: 1) wants fully transparent label (not frosted glass), 2) video switching causes freeze. Started investigation via log analysis and SingleScreenView.swift exploration. Session interrupted before resolution Implementation & Fixes ✅ Generate MIHD weekly report visualizations — Created 3 summary charts (method ranking bar, section heatmap, PCA vs scGPT comparison) + 33 per-section clustering plots (PCA/scGPT/UNI2 × 11 sections). Inserted into docs/experiments/weekly_report_20260301.md ✅ Fix Desktop Video errorLog() concurrency and log spam — Rewrote errorLog() to route through LogFile.shared.write() (eliminated concurrent FileHandle writes). Removed 879 updateClockLabels + 671 startScreensaverTimer dlog calls. Fixed double openMainWindow on launch ✅ Research and implement liquid glass screensaver clock — Researched SwiftUI .glassEffect() (macOS 26+) and backward-compatible .mask() approach for macOS 12.4+. Implemented glass text effect using .mask() + .ultraThinMaterial + specular gradient highlights. Time font changed to .thin. Removed background card entirely Problems & Solutions Critical Issues 1. Desktop Video: 100% failure rate restoring videos/images after app restart with Code 257 ‘Operation not permitted’ Solution: 4-part fix: 1) Add com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-scope to entitlements (was empty dict). 2) Add fallback in restoreFromBookmark: if .withSecurityScope fails, try options:[] to recover old non-scoped bookmarks, then re-save as scoped. 3) Track active URLs in activeSecurityScopedURLs dict, release in clear(). 4) ensureFileAccess() auto-resolves bookmarks before file I/O
Key Insight: macOS sandbox bookmark system requires BOTH compile-time entitlement declaration AND runtime URL.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() lifecycle management. Empty entitlements → bookmark creation silently falls back to non-scoped → restore with .withSecurityScope fails → Code 257. The 879-line errorLog() was never writing errors due to concurrent FileHandle race condition, masking the root cause for months
2. MIHD: STAIG two-stage fusion ignores gene encoder embeddings, making scGPT+UNI2+STAIG equivalent to PCA+UNI2+STAIG Solution: Traced through models/Fusion.py and pipeline/runner.py: staig_fusion uses staig_gene_feat (raw HVG matrix from cache) instead of gene_emb parameter. This is architectural, not a bug. Documented in weekly report as key finding that affects interpretation of all STAIG results
Key Insight: Gene encoder (PCA/scGPT) outputs are only utilized by non-STAIG fusion methods. For graph-based fusion like STAIG, the pretrained spatial embeddings don’t enter the GCN node features. This explains why scGPT underperforms: it’s optimized for cross-tissue generalization, not within-dataset variance maximization like PCA
3. VLA Evaluation: Low GPU utilization (~10%) in Pi0.5 evaluation pipeline despite 100% utilization during training, causing slow evaluation throughput Solution: Root cause identified: Action chunking architecture where Pi0.5 outputs 50-step action sequences reduces inference calls to only ~8 per 400-step trial (8 × 2.5s = 20s GPU work / 200s total = 10% utilization). Solution planning interrupted but optimization strategies requested via web research and batched evaluation implementation
Key Insight: VLA evaluation bottleneck is not GPU compute capacity but pipeline serialization: action chunking minimizes GPU calls, and each inference cycle includes CPU preprocessing, WebSocket I/O, and simulation steps that dominate total time. Batched inference with timer-based request collection could improve throughput
4. SSH access denied on GPU nodes an49/an53 due to PAM slurm_adopt rejecting connections with ’no active jobs on this node’ error Solution: Bypassed SSH restriction using Slurm’s srun command with –jobid flag to execute commands directly in allocated job context: srun --jobid=45628 bash -c 'command'
Key Insight: Slurm’s srun with –jobid provides a way to run commands on allocated nodes even when PAM blocks direct SSH, useful for cluster environments with strict access control
General Issues 5. Background task timeouts when using srun on heavily loaded GPU node (an49), with commands taking 60+ seconds to respond Solution: Added –overlap flag and reduced timeout expectations, falling back to simpler nvidia-smi when nvitop unavailable or too slow. Accepted that heavily loaded nodes have higher command latency
Key Insight: When GPU nodes are running 100% utilization workloads, administrative commands via srun can experience significant delays; design monitoring scripts to handle timeouts gracefully and use lightweight fallback commands
6. MIHD: mclust clustering hung indefinitely on scGPT (512d) and UNI2 (1536d) embeddings during visualization Solution: Switched from default mclust to kmeans via –cluster_method flag in visualize_from_cache.py. High-dimensional data causes mclust’s EM algorithm to become computationally intractable
Key Insight: Gaussian mixture model clustering (mclust) scales poorly beyond ~100 dimensions. For foundation model embeddings (512d-1536d), kmeans or spectral methods are necessary for practical runtime
7. Desktop Video log file filled with 1550+ spam entries per session (updateClockLabels × 879, startScreensaverTimer × 671) Solution: Removed dlog from updateClockLabels (called every second during screensaver). Moved dlog in startScreensaverTimer to after all early-exit guards (only logs when actually scheduling timer). Removed dlog from idle timer callback
Key Insight: High-frequency dlog calls in timer callbacks create massive log files that obscure real errors. Logging should be gated on state transitions, not periodic ticks
Human vs AI Approaches Strategic Level MIHD: Recognizing that scGPT+UNI2+STAIG should equal PCA+UNI2+STAIG Role Approach Human User (Yi Zhang) noticed from pilot results that scGPT spatial embeddings ’look similar to PCA’ and suspected gene encoder might not be used in STAIG fusion AI Assistant initially planned to run all scGPT+UNI2 fusion experiments to get the STAIG ARI, assuming gene encoder would be utilized Difference Analysis: Human intuition from domain expertise (scGPT as dimensionality reducer) led to hypothesis before code verification. Assistant followed literal task (get ARI number) without questioning the fusion architecture. Human-driven investigation revealed the actual implementation detail
VLA: GPU utilization root cause analysis approach Role Approach Human User provided detailed mathematical breakdown: Pi0.5 outputs 50-step chunks, 400-step trials need only ~8 inference calls, 2.5s per call = 20s GPU / 200s total = 10% utilization, with further breakdown of CPU vs GPU work within each 2.5s inference cycle AI AI would have likely started with profiling tools or log analysis to identify the bottleneck empirically before deriving the mathematical model Difference Analysis: User demonstrated systems-level thinking by reasoning from architecture (action chunking design) to derive expected utilization mathematically, rather than relying on measurement-first debugging. This shows deep understanding of the VLA inference pipeline structure
Desktop Video: Diagnosing bookmark bug via log archaeology vs direct code inspection Role Approach Human User provided symptom description and log file location, allowing evidence-based diagnosis AI Assistant read 4438-line log file to discover ‘saved non-scoped bookmark’ pattern (never ‘saved security-scoped’), traced back to empty entitlements file via code search, then verified hypothesis Difference Analysis: Log-driven debugging revealed runtime behavior (bookmark creation always non-scoped) that wouldn’t be obvious from static code analysis alone. The root cause (empty entitlements) was invisible in logs but became clear once non-scoped pattern was identified
VLA: External dependencies documentation format Role Approach Human User wanted a clear, structured file inventory listing exact paths, purposes, and reference locations in codebase for each external dependency AI AI initially created EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md with more narrative, documentation-style content explaining concepts and usage patterns Difference Analysis: User recognized need for operational reference (what files exist where) vs explanatory documentation (how to use them). User provided explicit plan specifying table-based structure with paths/purposes/references. This shows user’s understanding that different documentation serves different purposes
Implementation Level Desktop Video: Using existing visualize_from_cache.py instead of writing new script Role Approach Human User interrupted and said ‘don’t rewrite script, use the existing visualize’ after assistant wrote new visualize_weekly_report.py AI Assistant created a custom visualization script (visualize_weekly_report.py with matplotlib/seaborn) to generate 3 summary charts, without checking if existing scripts could be adapted Difference Analysis: Human preferred reusing battle-tested code (visualize_from_cache.py) over creating new scripts. Assistant optimized for exact specification match over codebase consistency. In this case, both approaches succeeded: the new script generated summary charts (method ranking, heatmap, comparison), existing script generated per-section plots
AI Limitations Critical Limitations Failed to question task assumptions in MIHD scGPT experiment. When asked to ‘get scGPT+UNI2+STAIG ARI’, assistant should have verified whether STAIG fusion actually uses gene encoder embeddings before running expensive 25-minute experiments. Human’s casual observation (’looks similar to PCA’) was the key to discovering architectural insight Desktop Video debugging: assistant rewrote errorLog() to fix concurrency but didn’t explain why NO error logs appeared in the 4438-line file. The race condition caused complete log loss, not just corruption. Should have called this out as ‘critical: errorLog has been silently failing, all historical errors are missing’ General Limitations Multiple tool call failures when attempting direct SSH to GPU nodes (an49/an53), not immediately recognizing that PAM slurm_adopt restrictions required srun-based access pattern. Should have identified the access control pattern after first failure instead of retrying SSH multiple times Initial EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md was more narrative/explanatory rather than the structured inventory format the user wanted, requiring explicit plan with table-based specification. Should have asked clarifying questions about documentation purpose (operational reference vs conceptual guide) before writing MIHD visualization: assistant created new script (visualize_weekly_report.py) without exploring existing visualization infrastructure first. Should have used Agent tool to survey all visualize_*.py scripts before deciding to write new code. User had to interrupt and redirect Learnings Key Learnings Foundation model embeddings (scGPT 512d, UNI2 1536d) are NOT drop-in replacements for dimensionality reduction (PCA 50d) in clustering tasks. scGPT optimizes for cross-dataset transfer, not within-dataset variance. Architecture choice (gene-only vs multimodal fusion) matters more than embedding quality: QFormer achieved 2× ARI improvement over scGPT-alone by learning gene-vision alignment. STAIG graph-based fusion completely ignores gene encoder outputs, using raw HVG matrix instead Action chunking in VLA models fundamentally changes the GPU utilization profile: Pi0.5 outputs 50-step action sequences, so a 400-step evaluation trial requires only ~8 inference calls (~20s GPU work) vs 200s total time, resulting in ~10% GPU utilization. The bottleneck shifts from GPU compute to pipeline serialization (CPU preprocessing, WebSocket I/O, simulation steps). Batched evaluation with timer-based request collection could improve throughput macOS sandbox security-scoped bookmarks require both compile-time entitlement declaration (in .entitlements file) AND runtime lifecycle management (startAccessingSecurityScopedResource/stop). Empty entitlements → silent fallback to non-scoped bookmarks → 100% restore failure. Bookmark system has no visible error channel when entitlements are missing Log archaeology (reading full log files) can reveal patterns invisible in code: Desktop Video’s ‘saved non-scoped bookmark’ repeated 20× across sessions exposed the missing entitlements. Concurrent write bugs (errorLog FileHandle race) silently destroy diagnostic information. High-frequency timer logs (879 updateClockLabels calls) obscure real errors → need state-based logging, not tick-based Slurm’s srun with –jobid flag can bypass SSH PAM restrictions (like slurm_adopt) by executing commands directly in the allocated job context, essential for cluster environments with strict node access control. When GPU nodes are running 100% utilization workloads, administrative commands via srun can experience significant latency (60+ seconds) → robust monitoring scripts should handle timeouts gracefully and use lightweight fallback commands (nvidia-smi over nvitop) External dependency documentation should serve operational purposes (structured inventory: paths, sizes, purposes, references) distinct from conceptual documentation (explanatory guides). Clear file inventories with exact paths enable reproducibility and dependency auditing. For VLA benchmark project, comprehensive inventory includes 14 categories: config directories, logs, binaries, environment variables, Python packages, rclone paths, Git repos, Ollama models, conda envs, datasets, checkpoints, bootstrap procedures, and troubleshooting guides Practical Learnings SwiftUI .mask() + .ultraThinMaterial enables ‘frosted glass text’ effect on macOS 12.4+ by masking the material blur to the text shape. The material automatically samples content beneath it in the window’s view hierarchy (video player → material → masked text). Dual-layer approach (material mask + gradient overlay) simulates physical glass with refraction + specular highlights Gaussian mixture model clustering (mclust) scales poorly beyond ~100 dimensions. For foundation model embeddings (512d-1536d), kmeans or spectral methods are necessary for practical runtime. mclust’s EM algorithm becomes computationally intractable on high-dimensional data Conversation Summaries MIHD Spatial Transcriptomics ✅ scGPT+UNI2 fusion experiments, weekly report preparation, and visualization generation 04:12:09.065 | claude_code PI requested scGPT+UNI2+STAIG results for Monday presentation. Investigation revealed STAIG two-stage fusion ignores gene encoder embeddings (uses raw HVG matrix instead). Repaired scGPT cache metadata, re-evaluated gene-only baseline (ARI 0.114→0.170), ran 5 fusion methods (concat/mean/attention/llava_mlp/qformer) across 11 sections. QFormer achieved best scGPT fusion (ARI 0.370). Created visualize_weekly_report.py for 3 summary charts (method ranking bar, section heatmap, PCA vs scGPT comparison). User redirected to use existing visualize_from_cache.py for per-section plots. Generated 36 total visualizations (3 summary + 33 per-section for PCA/scGPT/UNI2 encoders) and documented key architectural finding in weekly report
Desktop Video Wallpaper 🔄 Security-scoped bookmark system fix, liquid glass screensaver redesign, and ongoing debugging 22:35:54.328 | claude_code User reported video files failing to load with ‘Operation not permitted’ error after app restart. Root cause analysis via 4438-line log revealed: 1) Empty entitlements file → bookmark creation always non-scoped, 2) errorLog() concurrent writes lost all error logs, 3) 1550+ spam log entries per session, 4) Double window open on launch. Fixed by adding bookmark.app-scope entitlement, implementing non-scoped fallback parsing, rewriting errorLog to use shared LogFile, removing high-frequency dlogs, fixing launch sequence. Redesigned screensaver clock from card-based to Liquid Glass effect using .mask() + .ultraThinMaterial + specular gradient (text itself is frosted glass). User then requested fully transparent label (not frosted) and reported video switching freeze issue. Started investigation via log analysis and SingleScreenView.swift exploration but session was interrupted before resolution
Error Recovery Benchmark 🔄 Pi0.5 VLA training monitoring, external dependencies inventory, and GPU utilization optimization planning 06:44:17.740 | claude_code User requested comprehensive training status across GPU cluster. Successfully gathered data via Slurm commands (srun –jobid to bypass PAM restrictions), analyzed training logs, and delivered detailed report: 6 Pi0.5 LoRA tasks on an49 (38.3% progress, ~37h remaining, 7/8 GPUs at 100%), 4 tasks on an53 (26.8% progress, ~46h remaining, 7/8 GPUs at 100%), plus evaluation status (Stack tasks 95-100% success, Coffee tasks 5-25%). Created comprehensive external dependencies inventory (docs/external_dependencies_inventory.md) with 14 categories cataloging 65+ GB: configuration directories, AI assistant logs, external binaries, environment variables, Python packages, Google Drive rclone paths, external Git repos, Ollama models, 4 conda envs, 10 HDF5 datasets (~18.4GB), 9 BC-RNN checkpoints, 4 VLA checkpoints (~47GB), bootstrap procedures, and troubleshooting guides. title: Bug Journal 2026-03-02

content:
Weekly Report — 2026-W09 (2026-02-23 ~ 2026-03-01) This week, two main tracks were advanced concurrently on the DCC and Tianhe clusters: space transcriptomics (MIHD) and robot error recovery benchmark. On DCC, a fatal weight loading bug in scGPT was fixed (ARI improved by 44.4% on average), the MIHD benchmark was extended to the Visium HD dataset, and a large-scale repository refactoring of approximately 250K lines of code was completed; on Tianhe, the BC-RNN Phoenix baseline training pipeline was built from scratch (9 tasks parallelized), the root cause of 0% success rate in Pi0.5 evaluation was identified and fixed, key conclusions were obtained from M14 baseline evaluation (learning strategy yields SR≈0 in error scenarios, proving the necessity of M15 LoRA fine-tuning), and Pi0.5 LoRA 9 tasks were successfully fine-tuned parallelly on 6×A800 with stable startup.
Weekly Overview Metric Value Date Range 2026-02-23 ~ 2026-03-01 Active Days 5 / 7 Total Conversations 19 Projects Involved 5 Tasks Completed 35 Ongoing Tasks 6 Total Tokens 177,973,151 Total Cost $105.52 Average Daily Cost $21.10 Project Progress Error Recovery Benchmark (Robot Error Recovery Benchmark) (5 active days) — 🔄 active Completed:
M14 triple evaluation (Pi0/Pi0.5/BC-RNN) completed: BC-RNN SR=0.28%, Pi0/Pi0.5 SR=0%, while Random’s Recovery Progress is the highest, proving that learning strategies fail severely in distribution externalization under error injection scenarios, directly confirming the necessity of M15 LoRA fine-tuning Root cause of 0% success rate in Pi0.5 evaluation identified and fixed: Training task (MimicGen Task 5) and evaluation task (PickPlace) do not overlap at all; evaluation was moved to the training task BC-RNN Phoenix baseline fully implemented: image mode configuration rewritten (in line with MimicGen paper), 9 tasks trained parallelly and稳定运行, 64% SR reached after 22 epochs on Stack D0 Coffee BC-RNN configuration defect fixed: 57-dimensional object observation keys independently identified and added, fixing the root cause of Coffee’s 0% SR BC-RNN Stack_D0 error scenario generation pipeline completed: bug in 4-layer continuous image format fixed, 11 tip_over scenarios and MP4 visualizations generated Pi0.5 LoRA 9 tasks fine-tuned parallelly successfully started (6×A800, GPU utilization 100%, 77.7GB/card) Evaluation framework extended to 5 MimicGen tasks, with new task registry + –task parameter for unified management Pi0.5 Phoenix 9 task basic model evaluation: total SR=4.2% (24% on Stack D0, the rest ≤2%) 649 scenario database composition discovered: ~519 compatible scenarios + ~130 natural_* incompatible scenarios, actual valid evaluation targets are ~519 Blocked Items:
⚠️ Coffee environment initialization has object penetration/crushing issues (simulator bug), visualization of BC-RNN rollout shows the fix is incomplete ⚠️ Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning effect (compared to 4.2% baseline) will be verified after training completion MIHD (Multimodal Space Transcriptomics Fusion) (3 active days) — 🔄 active Completed:
Fixed fatal weight loading bug in scGPT: omission of self.use_fast_transformer in TransformerModel.init caused 17.7% random initialization of attention weights, after fixing, ARI improved by 44.4% and NMI improved by 33.3% STAIG fusion RM-IDEAL evaluation is significantly ahead (avg r=0.396 for 151673, peak r=0.644 for Layer_3), proving that multimodal fusion far exceeds single-modal baselines in capturing spatial niche structures (avg r≈0.06–0.12) Full support for Visium HD crop10large entire pipeline: 8 files modified, 4 path adaptation bugs fixed, end-to-end Silhouette=0.343 verified (vs PCA 0.086) VisiumHD barcode mapping discovered (r_big//4 pattern), three types of visualizations completed: pathologist annotation, STHD cell type, and STAIG fusion clustering comparison Vision Refine comparison experiment: found that scan_cluster refine is beneficial for weak fusion and harmful for strong fusion, qformer+no-refine is optimal (ARI=0.4832) Large-scale refactoring in Stage 6 of the repository: 41 files/~250K code + 5.3MB images removed, 6 functional modules extracted, 440 experiments verified via dry_run, logic reversal bug in BasicContrastive drop_feature fixed Three CPU acceleration implementations for STAIG fusion (cdist vectorization + GPUized random numbers + batch forward, expected 20–50x acceleration) Blocked Items:
⚠️ DLPFC slice 151676 has stable training collapse (NaN from epoch 1), requires independent parameter tuning, no fundamental solution currently Key Tasks- ✅ Fixes the scGPT use_fast_transformer weight loading bug and extracts all embeddings again (2026-02-28) — Omission of self.use_fast_transformer in TransformerModel.__init__ caused the key remapping in load_pretrained() to never execute, resulting in random initialization of all 12-layer attention Q/K/V weights (17.7% of parameters). After fixing a single line of code, ARI improved by 44.4%, and all 186/186 parameters matched. ✅ Identified the root cause of OOM during full fine-tuning of Pi0.5 and switched to LoRA architecture (2026-02-23) — Confirmed that JAX FSDP only slices parameter storage without reducing activation memory. The complete training state of Pi0.5 requires ~62GB/GPU, exceeding the A800 limit. Switching to gemma_2b_lora+gemma_300m_lora reduced VRAM to ~22.5GB, and Job 46553 ran stably at 2.0s/step. ✅ Completed the three-way evaluation of M14 and confirmed key conclusions (2026-02-27) — BC-RNN SR = 0.28%, Pi0/Pi0.5 SR = 0%, and the Random Recovery Progress (0.0199) was higher than all learning strategies. This proves that learning strategies fail severely in distribution外 generalization under error injection, directly supporting the necessity of M15 LoRA fine-tuning. ✅ Phase 6 cleanup and refactoring of the MIHD repository (2026-03-01) — Phase1 removed 41 dead files (~250K code + 5.3MB images); in Phases 2–4, shared functions in run_benchmark.py were migrated to 6 modules, and the bug of inverted logic in BasicContrastive drop_feature (>= changed to <) was fixed; a dry-run verified that 440 experiments passed. ✅ Full support for Visium HD crop10large across all links (8 files modified) (2026-02-28) — Modified the four modules in data_loader/clustering/run_benchmark/pipeline, added automatic clustering of HD without annotations (Leiden-estimated k), dedicated visualization logic for HD, and the hd_global configuration section, fixed coordinate space alignment and double preprocessing issues, and end-to-end verified Silhouette = 0.343. ✅ Identified and fixed compatibility issues in M14 scenarios (2026-02-23) — All three-way evaluations crashed on scene 122. AI analysis of EnvironmentMismatchError revealed that the 649 scenario library contained two types of environments (~519 compatible + ~130 natural_* incompatible). collector.py added a scene-level try-except to fix it, and the actual valid evaluation scenarios are about 519. 🔄 Built and started the parallel fine-tuning pipeline for Pi0.5 LoRA 9 tasks (2026-03-01) — Created train_pi05_benchmark.py (5 sub-commands), registered 18 configurations in openpi/config.py, and fixed 4 startup bugs (JAX_PLATFORMS, norm_stats path, boolean parameters, W&B agent), starting successfully with 6×A800, 100% GPU utilization, and 77.7GB/card. 🔄 Implemented the BC-RNN Phoenix baseline script and started parallel training for 9 tasks (2026-02-28) — Implemented train_bc_rnn_benchmark.py based on hyperparameters from the MimicGen paper, fixed 3 library-level bugs (mujoco_py import, MimicGen environment registration, inheritance chain in get_bounding_box_half_size), and parallelized 9 tasks on a single GPU (~2.2GB VRAM/task), including 50 rollout evaluations every 20 epochs. ✅ Identified and fixed the missing object observation keys in Coffee BC-RNN (2026-03-01) — By comparing the actual obs key structure of the HDF5 dataset, it was found that Coffee lacks 57-dimensional object states (Pod/Machine/Holder position + relative pose + hinge angle). Added extra_low_dim=['object'] for all 9 tasks, fixing the root cause of 0% SR in Coffee. ✅ Identified and fixed the root cause of 0% success rate in Pi0.5 evaluation (2026-02-26) — Confirmed that the training task (MimicGen 5 task) and the evaluation task (PickPlace) do not overlap at all; changed to evaluate on the training task. Human analysis directly pointed out the issue, and the AI’s initial analysis failed to identify this most obvious cause immediately. ✅ Rewritten the BC-RNN image mode configuration (5 tasks, consistent with MimicGen paper) (2026-02-26) — Rewritten all bc_rnn_configs from low_dim to image mode: ResNet18 + SpatialSoftmax encoder, CropRandomizer 76×76, RNN hidden_dim 1000, batch_size 16, epoch_every_n_steps 500, consistent with the main results of the MimicGen paper. ✅ Implemented three CPU acceleration methods for MIHD fusion training (2026-02-23) — Replaced scipy cdist vectorization with O(n²) nested loops (~100–500x), migrated random number generation to GPU to eliminate per-epoch transmission overhead, and added a batch forward interface to QFormerFusion (expected 20–50x). ✅ Developed the pipeline for generating error scenarios in BC-RNN Stack_D0 (2026-03-01) — Fixed four consecutive bugs in accessing image observations in robomimic BC-RNN (enable_camera detection, json.loads parsing checkpoint config, automatic detection of 84×84 resolution, HWC→CHW transpose + normalization), generating 11 tip_over error scenarios and MP4 visualizations. ✅ Full evaluation of RM-IDEAL across 27 embedding methods × 7 layers (2026-02-28) — Ran the full RM-IDEAL evaluation with 27 embedding methods, generated 189 three-panel visualizations for Zhang, and staig_fusion ranked first with an average r=0.396 (peak r=0.644 at Layer_3), quantifying the advantage of multi-modal fusion. ✅ Extended the evaluation framework to 5 MimicGen tasks (2026-02-26) — Created 5 new task YAML configs + task_registry.yaml, added --task parameter to the 1/3/4 scripts, fixed the observation dimension error caused by _D0 env suffix stripping (65→37), and rewritten run_full_eval.sh to support multi-task loops. ✅ Full slice benchmark for STAIG fusion (11 DLPFC slices) (2026-02-23) — Ran pca+uni2+staig_fusion and none+uni2+staig_fusion on 11 DLPFC slices, fixed the UNI2 patch_size compatibility bug (256×256→224×224), with success in 10/11 slices and an average ARI=0.546; known collapse at 151676. ✅ Comparison experiment between MIHD Vision Refine and Baseline (2026-02-23) — Ran full comparisons of 8 fusion methods with/without scan_cluster refine on slice 151673, and qformer+no-refine was optimal (ARI=0.4832). Found that refine is beneficial for weak fusion (attention +0.086) but harmful for strong fusion (qformer -0.054). ✅ Fixed key bugs in evaluate_mimicgen.py and collector.py (2026-02-23) — Fixed the in-place array modification bug in quat2axisangle (used np.clip+copy), captured EnvironmentMismatchError at the scene level in collector.py, ensured reproducibility with env.seed(), and verified the 8D state dimension assert. Issues and Solutions 1. Pi0.5 full fine-tuning training requires ~62GB/GPU, and JAX FSDP=4 cannot effectively reduce VRAM (only slicing storage does not reduce activation memory), repeatedly causing OOM [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-23) Solution: Switch to the gemma_2b_lora+gemma_300m_lora architecture, reducing training parameters by ~90% and reducing VRAM to ~22.5GB/GPU. Job 46553 runs stably at 2.0s/step.
2. All three-way evaluations of M14 crashed on scene 122/649: ~130 natural_* scenario XML hashes are incompatible with the current Mimicgen environment, triggering EnvironmentMismatchError without detection, causing the entire evaluation process to crash [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-23) Solution: Add a try-except for EnvironmentMismatchError in collector.py’s collect_on_scenes()for each scene, skip incompatible scenarios and log warnings, and restart with–resume`. The actual valid evaluation scenarios are about 519.
3. Training logs are severely distorted due to stdout buffering: Pi0.5 training shows only ~580 steps, but actually reached step 3000, leading to misjudged training termination and unnecessary restart [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-23) Solution: Add PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1+stdbuf -oL to the training script and sbatch submission scripts; use sbatch for long-term training and decouple the independent batch job from the interactive session lifecycle.
4. The success rate of Pi0.5 evaluation is 0%, misjudged as model quality issues [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-26) Solution: Confirmed that the training task (MimicGen 5 task) and the evaluation task (PickPlace) do not overlap at all; change to evaluating on the training tasks (Coffee/Stack/Threading/Assembly).
5. Observation dimension mismatch in BC-RNN evaluation (Expected 65, got 37) [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-26) Solution: Add a import mimicgen registration for the _D0 environment in create_env(); stop stripping the _D0 suffix and retain all MimicGen observables (_D0 environment provides additional object state observables).
6. scGPT TransformerModel.__init__ omits self.use_fast_transformer, causing the key remapping in load_pretrained() to never execute, and 17.7% attention weights are randomly initialized; strict=False silently skips without error [MIHD] (2026-02-28) Solution: Add a single line self.use_fast_transformer = use_fast_transformer in model.py. After fixing, ARI improved by 44.4%, and all 11 DLPFC slice embeddings were extracted again.
7. WebSocket client always reports ConnectionRefusedError; attempts with different address formats (localhost/127.0.0.1/0.0.0.0) all fail [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-28) Solution: Found that the http_proxy environment variable is set to 127.0.0.1:10087; the websockets library fails due to connection through the proxy.After unsetting all proxy variables at the beginning of run_eval.sh, the connection was established successfully.
8. CoffeeMachineBodyObject lacks the get_bounding_box_half_size() method, causing an AttributeError during the initialization of the MimicGen Coffee task rollout (An interface gap between MimicGen and the current robosuite version) [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-02-28)Solution: Trace the entire call chain (coffee_machine.py→CoffeeMachineBodyObject→CompositeBodyObject→MujocoXMLObject), and implement get_bounding_box_half_size() in three different base classes. 9. The HD data uns[‘spatial’] image is a full-resolution image, but its coordinates are in the cropped fullres pixel space, resulting in a mismatch during visualization; moreover, since X has been logged transformed, the pipeline will again normalize_total+log1p, causing a double transformation [MIHD] (2026-02-28) Solution: Replace the uns[‘spatial’] image with cropped_fullres.tif in load_hd_data() and recalculate the scalefactor; add the skip_log parameter to preprocess_data(), and pass skip_log=True for HD data only for HVG filtering.
10. The Coffee BC-RNN loss converges normally (-7.66→-15.4), but SR remains 0% all the time. With the same configuration, epoch 20 already reaches 64%, showing a high similarity to insufficient model capacity [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-03-01) Solution: Compare with the actual obs key structure of the HDF5 dataset, and find that Coffee requires a 57-dimensional object state (required for multi-stage precise operations), and the configuration template lacks this field; add extra_low_dim=[‘object’] for all 9 tasks and regenerate the configuration.
11. The robomimic BC-RNN image observation access fails at four consecutive levels: the detection logic of enable_camera/checkpoint config is in JSON string format/image resolution acquisition/HWC→CHW format conversion all have issues [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-03-01) Solution: ① Detect the rgb modality from the JSON string of checkpoint config (needs json.loads); ② Read the actual 84×84 size from shape_metadata; ③ Manually transpose HWC→CHW and convert uint8→float32/255 normalization (ObsUtils.process_obs automatically handles it in the standard rollout).
12. Pi0.5 LoRA training starts with four consecutive blocking bugs: ① Setting JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu separately is ineffective; ② Wrong path for norm_stats; ③ Boolean parameter–overwrite=False is ineffective; ④ Access to W&B external network on HPC nodes is blocked [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-03-01) Solution: ① Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""+JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu simultaneously; ② The actual path for norm_stats is assets//benchmark//norm_stats.json; ③ Use–no-overwrite instead; ④ Predefine WANDB_MODE=disabled.
13. VisiumHD HD data pipeline path adaptation: The image path lookup in the vision encoder and spatial coords loading during fusion fail because they assume the DLPFC directory structure [MIHD] (2026-03-01) Solution: Add the cropped_fullres.tif pattern recognition to find_spatial_image(); pass the crop_dir.parent as data_root when calling the vision encoder; directly load coordinates from adata.obsm[‘spatial’] during fusion to bypass path lookup.
14. When calculating norm_stats, GPU util=0 but memory is fully used, and the task progresses slowly for a long time; the root cause is that PaligemmaTokenizer loads eagerly on all visible GPUs when calling get_config().model [Error Recovery Benchmark] (2026-03-01) Solution: Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""+JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu simultaneously; ② The actual path for norm_stats is assets//benchmark//norm_stats.json; ③ Use–no-overwrite instead; ④ Predefine WANDB_MODE=disabled.
15. Architecture (architecture) JAX FSDP only splits parameter storage, which does not affect the full model loading and forward activation memory during initialization; the full training state of Pi0.5 requires ~62GB/GPU, and a single A800 with 80GB cannot support full fine-tuning; LoRA (gemma_2b_lora) is the only viable solution for the A800 cluster, reducing memory demand to ~22.5GB. When the warning “Can’t reduce memory use below 62.46GiB” appears, switch to LoRA immediately. The observation keys in BC-RNN configurations must match task complexity: Tasks like Coffee requiring multi-stage precise operations need a 57-dimensional object state, and a 84×84 image cannot provide sufficient spatial precision; the behavior of configuration bugs (normal loss but SR=0) is highly similar to insufficient model capacity, and differentiation requires comparison with dataset structures. Vectorization and batching accelerate significantly: O(n²) nested loops → cdist matrix operation approximately 100–500x, Python逐spot loops → batch GPU forward预计 20–50x. The calculation of norm_stats completely does not require model inference; forcing CPU mode + subsampling + parallelization can reduce the time from 10+ minutes to 2.5 minutes. Methodology for refactoring large repositories: Systematically grep to verify all imported dependencies → execute in the order of “create new module→update references→delete old files” → dry-run verification; before merging multiple functions with the same name, carefully compare boundary conditions (> vs >= vs < can lead to completely opposite functions). Debugging (debugging) PyTorch model.load_state_dict(strict=False) silently ignores mismatched keys, and key weights may run as random values for a long time without reporting any errors; production code should actively print missing_keys/unexpected_keys and verify parameter value statistics. Similar bugs may exist in upstream open-source repositories, and the weight loading path needs active auditing rather than blind trust. Key details of robomimic BC-RNN inference: Checkpoint config is stored as a JSON string (needs json.loads, not direct dict access); when bypassing the standard rollout process, manually transpose HWC→CHW and convert uint8→float32/255 normalization (ObsUtils.process_obs automatically handles it in the standard rollout). Domain knowledge (domain) Key conclusion from M14: BC-RNN SR=0.28%, Pi0/Pi0.5 SR=0%, and Random’s Recovery Progress (0.0199) is higher than all learning strategies—learning strategies suffer from serious distribution external generalization failure in error injection scenarios, directly proving the necessity of LoRA fine-tuning in M15. The 649 scenario database consists of two types of environments: ~519 impulse/augmented compatible scenarios (xml_hash matching) and ~130 natural_* natural capture scenarios (xml_hash different). Approximately 519 actual valid evaluation scenarios exist in M14, and all document and target episode counts need corresponding updates. STAIG fusion leads comprehensively in RM-IDEAL evaluation (average r=0.396 for 151673, peak r=0.644 for Layer_3), and multi-modal fusion has a much better ability to capture spatial niche structures than single-modal baselines (gene/vision avg r≈0.06–0.12). Vision Refine performance is polarized: beneficial for weak fusion (attention +0.086 ARI), harmful for strong fusion (qformer -0.054); strong fusion already has the ability to handle high-dimensional inputs, and dimensionality reduction loses information. Cross-task evaluation is a common trap in robot learning: Non-overlap between training set tasks and evaluation tasks directly leads to 0% SR; ensure train/eval task consistency during experimental design. The MimicGen _D0 environment provides additional object observables; removing the _D0 suffix reduces the observation dimension from 65 to 37, breaking input consistency during inference. VisiumHD coordinate mapping: r_big//4 of 2um bin gives 8um grid row (same for col); the spatial visualization size parameter in scanpy is a multiple of spot_diameter_fullres; HD 8μm (diameter≈7.3) requires size≈4.0, DLPFC (diameter≈144) uses size=1.0; the Leiden community found that (resolution=1.0) is the default clustering strategy for unlabeled HD data (crop10large k=17, Silhouette=0.302). Tools (tools) Best practices for Slurm cluster training engineering: Long-term training requires using sbatch (not srun to avoid session timeout due to SIGTERM); standardize all training scripts with PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1+stdbuf -oL; clean zombie GPU processes with fuser /dev/nvidiaX before starting (monitoring tools like nvitop also hold CUDA context); MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID corresponds to the physical GPU number rather than the logic of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Key configurations for JAX/Pi0.5 training: ① Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""+JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu in CPU mode; ② XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.95 is effective for A800 80GB (61→77.7GB); ③ HPC nodes must predefine WANDB_MODE=disabled; ④ Use–no-overwrite for argparse boolean flags, not–flag=False; ⑤ The path for openpi norm_stats is assets//benchmark//norm_stats.json. The HTTP/HTTPS proxy environment variable (http_proxy) is transparently proxied by the Python websockets library, so unset the proxy variable when debugging local services on HPC clusters. The MimicGen environment registers via the side effect of import mimicgen in robosuite; explicit execution of this import is required before calling external tools. Fixing methods missing in third-party libraries must be implemented in the entire inheritance chain across all base classes, and fixing only the recently called point will cause errors in other subclasses. The pam_slurm_adopt cluster GPU nodes do not support direct SSH; srun –overlap can attach new steps to existing interactive jobs to reuse node resources; robomimic in a non-TTY environment will exit with EOFError if a checkpoint directory already exists, so clean the directory thoroughly before each start. summary: This week, two main tracks—space transcriptomics (MIHD) and robot error recovery benchmark—were advanced in parallel on both DCC and Tianhe clusters. On DCC, the bug related to fatal weight loading in scGPT was fixed (average ARI improvement of 44.4%), the MIHD benchmark was extended to the Visium HD dataset, and a large-scale repository refactoring of approximately 250K lines of code was completed; on Tianhe, the BC-RNN Phoenix baseline training pipeline was established from scratch (9 tasks run in parallel), the root cause of the 0% success rate in the Pi0.5 evaluation was identified and fixed, key conclusions were obtained for the M14 baseline evaluation (the learning strategy achieves SR≈0 in error scenarios, proving the necessity of M15 LoRA fine-tuning), and the Pi0.5 LoRA 9 task was successfully fine-tuned in parallel on 6×A800 with stable operation.

content:
Daily Report — 2026-03-01 Daily Overview What was done: Parallel execution across three compute environments: spatial transcriptomics visualization and codebase modernization on HPC (DCC), robot learning model training and cluster infrastructure management on supercomputer (tianhe), and development tooling enhancement plus retrospective documentation on local workstation (MacBook) How it was done: DCC leveraged STHD/STAIG pipelines with dataset compatibility fixes and systematic code refactoring via multi-phase plans; tianhe utilized Slurm job scheduling for iterative training debugging and GPU resource optimization; MacBook employed automated log consolidation via gadget/summarize tool and plan-driven multi-file coordinated edits Impact: Successfully unified multi-modal annotation sources for VisiumHD analysis with 100% match rate; transformed MIHD from 136K-line monolith to modular architecture; established comprehensive February development history through 28+ automated reports; achieved production-ready robot learning baselines (BC-RNN 98% on Stack, Pi0.5 4.2% Phoenix evaluation) with 6-GPU parallel training at 95% memory utilization; delivered Desktop Video 4.1 with critical playback bugs fixed and native macOS Tahoe aesthetics DCC What was done: Completed VisiumHD crop10large multi-source annotation visualization (Pathologist 100% match at 8um, STHD 96.3% coverage, STAIG fusion Silhouette 0.343), MIHD 6-phase codebase refactoring (deleted 250K+ dead code, extracted shared functions, verified integrity), generated Feb 28 work log with 60+ visualization links, and switched scGPT from mclust (40+ min/section) to KMeans (2 min/section) How it was done: Addressed HD dataset path incompatibilities through 5 debug rounds, implemented r_big//4 coordinate mapping for Zenodo annotations, used majority vote aggregation for STHD 2um→8um bins, executed gradual dependency-aware refactoring (migrate dependencies before deleting sources), verified via pipeline dry run (440 experiments) and grep for residual references Impact: Enabled direct comparison of pathologist expert knowledge vs computational predictions on clinical tissue; MIHD evolved from chaotic monolith to clean modular architecture (models/, utils/, pipeline/); accelerated scGPT workflow from 6+ hours to <3 minutes (360x speedup); established STAIG baseline performance on HD data MacBook What was done: Primary device executing three parallel workflows: batch historical report generation (28+ dates across February-March), merge workflow optimization (–sync day-by-day processing), and Desktop Video app enhancement (3 critical playback bugs + complete Liquid Glass UI redesign) How it was done: Automated multi-device log consolidation via daily_summary.py merge operations (export→merge→deploy pipeline); modified cmd_merge() to delegate to _cmd_merge_sync_all() when –sync used without –date; plan-driven coordinated edits for Desktop Video (7-file playback fix, 6-file UI polish) with comprehensive localization and build verification Impact: Successfully consolidated 25+ days into structured reports (3 failed due to 32K output limit); streamlined future batch operations eliminating 50+ manual commands; delivered Desktop Video 4.1 Preview 0301 with PowerSave/PowerSave+/Automatic modes fully functional and Liquid Glass upgraded to macOS Tahoe native design (.regular glass, Capsule containers, locale-aware formatting) tianhe What was done: Completed BC-RNN 9-task training (Stack 98% SR, Coffee 0% due to missing object obs), Phoenix Pi0.5 evaluation (4.2% overall SR, 450 episodes), diagnosed training failures, cleaned 468GB idle GPU VRAM, fixed Pi0.5 LoRA training pipeline through 5 debug cycles, and archived v4.17 project structure (mimicgen_workspace legacy code, external dependencies index) How it was done: Used Slurm overlap mode for GPU resource management; monitored training via filesystem polling and TensorBoard; iterative diagnosis of launch script (JAX CPU config, path mismatches, CLI flags, W&B disable); killed idle VLA servers (Phoenix/Pi0/Pi0.5); expanded GPU allocation from 4 to 6 with XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.95; bash script-based file archival Impact: Established BC-RNN baseline showing stack tasks achieve 44-98% success (validates training pipeline), identified Coffee 0% SR root cause (missing 57-dim object observation key); obtained complete Phoenix results across 9 tasks; freed critical GPU resources; achieved 6-GPU parallel training at 100% utilization with 77.7GB/GPU (95% memory allocation); systematically organized codebase with external dependencies documented TzJsDesktop What was done: Minor contributions to gadget tool: added conversation_summaries field to daily report structure How it was done: Schema enhancement via code edits Impact: Enabled richer historical documentation with per-project conversation breakdowns Cross-device intensive work: completed MIHD HD dataset integration with multi-source annotation validation, large-scale codebase refactoring (250K+ LOC cleanup), batch-generated 28+ historical daily reports with workflow optimization, fixed BC-RNN/Pi0.5 training pipelines achieving 6-GPU parallel training, and delivered Desktop Video 4.1 with playback fixes and Liquid Glass UI redesign
Tasks Architecture & Strategy ✅ STAIG Fusion HD Dataset Support — Fixed 6 technical issues (path handling, image patterns, coordinate loading, clustering fallback, stdout buffering) to enable PCA × UNI2 × STAIG fusion pipeline on HD crop10large; generated clustering visualization with Silhouette=0.343, k=20, 300 epochs training ✅ MIHD 6-Phase Codebase Refactoring — Phase 1: Deleted 41 dead files (~250K code + 5.3MB images). Phase 2: Extracted shared functions from run_benchmark.py (136K/3488 lines) to models/staig_utils.py, models/vision_extractors.py, models/Fusion.py, utils/clustering.py. Phase 3: Deleted run_benchmark.py and 6 dependent models. Phase 4: Extracted STAIG common code, fixed BasicContrastive drop_feature bug. Phase 5: Updated 5 documentation files, deleted benchmark_config.yaml. Phase 6: Verified pipeline imports, models imports, dry run (440 experiments), grep residual references ✅ BC-RNN Configuration Fix: Add Object Observation Key — Modified train_bc_rnn_benchmark.py to add extra_low_dim=[‘object’] for all 9 tasks, addressing Coffee 0% SR root cause (missing 57-dim object state including pod/holder positions). Regenerated all configs, verified changes, updated templates and documentation to v4.16 ✅ Fix Pi0.5 LoRA Training Pipeline (5 debug cycles) — Fixed launch script through iterative debugging: (1) added JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu for CPU-only norm_stats, (2) corrected norm_stats paths from checkpoints/ to assets/, (3) fixed –overwrite=False to –no-overwrite syntax, (4) added WANDB_MODE=disabled for HPC nodes, (5) expanded GPU array from 4 to 6 with XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.95 for 77.7GB/GPU allocation. Achieved 6-GPU parallel training at 100% utilization ✅ VisiumHD Pathologist Annotation Visualization and Mapping — Mapped Zenodo pathologist CSV (545,913 annotations) to 8um bins via r_big//4 coordinate transform achieving 100% match (17,502 bins), generated H&E + annotation dual-panel visualization identifying 4 spatial regions: Neoplasm (8498), Connective Tissue (5166), Non-neoplastic Epithelium (3826), Smooth Muscle (12) ✅ Desktop Video Playback Mode Bug Fixes (3 interconnected bugs) — Fixed: (1) PowerSave/PowerSave+ not delegating to global evaluation on new window creation, (2) Automatic mode missing Low Power Mode detection, (3) UI mode changes not triggering state re-evaluation. 7-file coordinated edit: AppState.swift (playbackMode.didSet), SharedWallpaperWindowManager.swift (delegate to global), AppDelegate.swift (NSProcessInfoPowerStateDidChange observer + isLowPowerModeEnabled), removed redundant onChange handlers, updated 5-language localization, ChangeLog entry for v4.1 Preview 0301 ✅ BC-RNN 9-Task Training and Evaluation — Monitored epoch 20 training across coffee_d0/d1, stack_d0/d1, stack_three_d0/d1, threading_d0, three_piece_assembly_d0/d1; first rollout evaluation: stack_d0 64%, stack_d1 44%, coffee series 0% (root cause: missing object observation key); final results: Stack D0/D1 98% SR, Coffee D0/D1 0% SR ✅ Phoenix Pi0.5 Evaluation (9 tasks × 50 episodes) — Completed full MimicGen benchmark evaluation for Pi0.5 Phoenix checkpoint step 99999. Overall success rate 4.2% (19/450), Stack tasks showed meaningful learning (24% D0, 12% D1), Coffee/StackThree/Threading/Assembly near 0% ✅ scGPT Clustering Performance Optimization — Switched from mclust (40+ min/section, 6+ hours for 11 sections) to KMeans completing all DLPFC sections in ~2 minutes, average ARI=0.1695, NMI=0.2772; 360x speedup with acceptable quality tradeoff ✅ Implement Gadget merge –sync Day-by-Day Processing — Modified cmd_merge() in daily_summary.py to automatically process logs day-by-day when –sync flag used without –date: checks args.date is None, delegates to _cmd_merge_sync_all() which groups files by date, spawns subprocess per day, skips existing reports, batch deploys at end ✅ Desktop Video UI Optimization: Liquid Glass + Duplicate Removal — Removed duplicate PlaybackMode picker and idlePauseSensitivity slider from GeneralSettingsView; redesigned CombinedGlassClock to macOS Tahoe native aesthetics (.regular glass with Capsule/RoundedRectangle, 28pt date/96pt time fonts, 20pt spacing, removed shadow, deleted GlassCompat); unified clock position factor to 0.85 constant; locale-aware date formatting via EEEEMMMMd template ✅ GPU VRAM Cleanup (Free 468GB) — Killed 3 idle VLA servers: Phoenix serve_policy.py (PID 2413737, ~407GB across 7 GPUs, 0% utilization), Pi0 server (PID 2138978, ~61GB), Pi0.5 server (PID 2046779, ~61GB). Freed GPUs 0-6 completely, only GPU 7 remains in use for BC-RNN training ✅ Error Recovery Benchmark Project Cleanup (v4.17) — Phase 1-4: archived top-level misc files (19MB PDFs), outdated docs (README_V4), mimicgen_workspace legacy code (v1-v3 frameworks, 13+ files), temp logs and pycache; merged VLM tutorials; created README.md, .gitignore, docs/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md; updated CLAUDE.md and project summary to v4.17 ✅ Gadget Finalize Mechanism for Merge Phase — In cmd_merge() tracked source log _finalized states; when target_date < today and all source logs finalized, set report._finalized=True; _cmd_merge_sync_all() skips finalized reports; added –force parameter to override checks and propagate to subprocesses Implementation & Fixes ✅ Batch-Generate February Historical Daily Reports (28+ dates) — Generated structured JSON/Markdown reports for Feb 1, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 (×3), 14 (×3), 15 (×2), 16, 17 (×3), 18, 19 (×3), 20, 22 (×2), 23, 26 (×2), 28 (×2), and Mar 1 by running daily_summary.py merge commands. Each consolidated multi-device logs covering MIHD/error-recovery-benchmark/CalendarPro/gadget projects. 3 complex days hit 32K output token limit ✅ Generate MIHD Feb 28 Work Log with Visualization Links — Created docs/experiments/daily_summary_20260228.md with 3 major directions (Visium HD support, Vision Refinement pipeline, performance optimization), 7 experiment groups (A-G) metrics tables, and 60+ PNG visualization links using relative paths for GitHub/Hugo rendering ✅ STHD/MIHD CLAUDE.md Enhancements — Enhanced STHD CLAUDE.md: added missing CLI commands (hdpp, sthdviz), detailed architecture for frontline/qcmask/roi/sim modules, pdata format specification, Numba JIT notes. Enhanced MIHD CLAUDE.md: added vision enhancement models (STEGO/BYOL/SCAN/SpatialGAT), HD dataset command examples, test scripts, cache directory clarification Problems & Solutions Critical Issues 1. VisiumHD dataset paths incompatible with DLPFC-oriented pipeline: image file mismatches, spatial coordinate loading failures, mclust not scaling to HD bin counts (17,502 bins vs DLPFC 4,992 spots) Solution: 5-round debugging: fixed path resolution logic, refactored coordinate loading, implemented mclust→KMeans fallback for large datasets, added tqdm + PYTHONUNBUFFERED for visibility. HD crop10large now runs through complete STAIG pipeline with 360x speedup (2 min vs 40+ min per section)
